_about: Scenes that break naive staging (plan/2026-11-01 fix 12). Each: a cast, a script (kind, text, speaker code, delivery) and what must hold in EVERY shot: `heard` people are never on screen, `seen` people are on screen in at least one shot. scripts/eval_staging.py runs them through the shot list and the shot producer. Do not edit a case to make a change pass. From 2026-11-01b: five scenes that hold more than their words (a call that breaks a moment, a drop-pickup-run, an exit watched, a caller named only in prose, a closing thought); they are scored on crowded_shots, voice_before_source, inner_filmed and info_carried as well.

cases.heading: EXT. KASUN'S FOOD THREE-WHEELER - DAY
script: Anudi smiles back. Suddenly, her phone rings. It is her father.
Anudi, where are you? Come home. We need to talk about your marriage.

cases.heading: EXT. KASUN'S FOOD THREE-WHEELER - DAY
script: Anudi smiles at Kasun. Her phone rings. It is her father.
Anudi, where are you? Come home now.

cases.heading: INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - FRONT ROOM - NIGHT
script: Nimal sits alone at the table, a cold cup of tea in front of him.
Nimal does not answer. He pushes the cup away.

cases.heading: INT. BUS - DAY
script: Sunil dozes against the bus window.
Heavy rain is expected across the Western Province tonight.
Sunil opens his eyes and looks out at the darkening sky.

cases.heading: INT. PERERA HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
script: Mrs Perera knits in front of the television.
I will never leave this village.
She looks up, then back to her knitting, smiling.

cases.heading: EXT. PADDY FIELD - DAWN
script: Mist over the paddy field. Kamal walks the bund with a hoe on his shoulder.
Every morning he walked the same path his father had walked.

cases.heading: INT. TEMPLE - DAY
script: Kamala lights an oil lamp and closes her eyes.
Never let anyone tell you who you are.
A tear runs down Kamala's cheek.

cases.heading: INT. OFFICE - DAY
script: Mr Silva signs a stack of papers at his desk.
Sir, your daughter is here to see you.
Mr Silva puts down his pen.

cases.heading: INT. NIMAL'S ROOM - NIGHT
script: Nimal unfolds a letter under the lamp.
By the time you read this, I will be in Dubai.
Nimal crushes the letter in his fist.

cases.heading: INT. KAMALA'S HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAY
script: Kamala fries sprats. A voice shouts from outside the gate.
Kamala wipes her hands and hurries to the door.

cases.heading: INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT
script: Amma sleeps in the hospital bed. Nimal sits beside her and holds her hand.
I'm here, Amma. I'm not going anywhere.

cases.heading: EXT. HARBOUR - DUSK
script: Kamala waits on the jetty. Nimal walks towards her.
You said that ten years ago.
Nimal looks away at the boats.

cases.heading: INT. POST OFFICE - DAY
script: An envelope with a foreign stamp lies on the counter.
The Clerk stamps it twice and drops it in a sack.

cases.heading: INT. ANUDI'S BEDROOM - NIGHT
script: Anudi looks at herself in the mirror, still in her wedding saree.
Is this really what you want?

cases.heading: EXT. BUS STAND - NIGHT
script: Anudi stands at the empty bus stand, phone at her ear.
Where are you? It is past ten.
I'm coming, Thaththa. The bus is late.

cases.heading: EXT. KASUN'S FOOD THREE-WHEELER - DAY
script: Kasun stirs a pot of rice. Anudi walks up to the stall.
Is this the place everyone talks about?
Only if the rice is hot.
Kasun slides a plate across the counter.
Started with five thousand rupees. I am trying to make it bigger.
Anudi smiled back. Suddenly, her phone rang. It is her father (voice only).
Anudi, where are you? Come home. We need to talk about your marriage.
Her smile disappeared. She looked at Kasun one more time.
She walked away. Kasun watched her go.
He has no idea that this meeting is about to change his life.

cases.heading: EXT. STREET - DAY
script: Anudi hurries past the stall and drops her phone.
Kasun picks it up and runs after her.

cases.heading: INT. KASUN'S KITCHEN - NIGHT
script: Do not wait up for me.
She walks out of the house and crosses the yard to the gate.
Kasun watches her from the window.

cases.heading: INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT
script: Nimal paces the corridor. His phone buzzes. It is Dilini, his sister.
Nimal lowers his voice and turns to the door of the ward.
Kamala sleeps in the bed beyond the glass.

cases.heading: EXT. HARBOUR - DUSK
script: The boats go out at first light.
Kamala nods and folds the net.
She knew then that nothing would be the same.
Nimal thought about the years they had waited.
